hypothesis_statement: The type of a single directed aromatic functionalization determines the mean change in Crippen logP of the frozen 48-compound Tox21 AR-agonist subset: hydroxylation lowers logP, chlorination and methylation raise it by distinct magnitudes, so the four arms yield distinct mean_delta_logp outcomes.
note: Frozen from a real offline RDKit run on the 48-compound subset (rdkit_version recorded in data/molecules.json). The judge alone reads this file; no arm code path references it.
